what: The top 0 to zone rows of the image inside the panel (video · photo · canvas) are replaced with the color of the single row at zone and stretched into vertical stripes (edge softened by .002). On load, zone goes 0 → .15 in 1.2s power2.out, then while the panel is pinned to the screen and +400% is scrolled, it descends with no curve at .15 + .83 × progress, ending with only the bottom row of the image (the flower stem) left as a vertical bar. look: stretch works like the original footer wordmark: while the panel top goes from 80% of the screen until its bottom edge reaches 90%, zone rises to .7, and the panel scales 2.5× vertically with the bottom as the axis.

options.start: Default top top (stretch type is top 80%)
options.look: stretch: Footer wordmark type — zone up to to (default .7), panel scaled vertically by scale (default 2.5)
options.[data-fx-part=source]: Image to stretch (required) — img · canvas · video. Images from another origin need crossorigin, and if it can’t be uploaded as a texture the image is left as is

use: …
note: A video re-uploads its texture every frame. Video and photos opened via file:// taint the canvas and can’t be uploaded as textures, so open over http or use a canvas drawing

from.where: index.html .es-hero (original #hero heroCanvas — three ShaderMaterial uZoneEnd) · footer .es-foot__canvas (original footerCanvas, look: stretch)
